# Hashnode

Hashnode is a blogging platform tailored for developers, offering tools to create, manage, and publish content seamlessly.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hashnode/.

## Actions

- **Fetch Publication Posts** (read-only): Fetch a paginated list of posts from a publication.
- **Fetch Single Article** (read-only): Fetch a single article by slug from a publication.
- **Fetch Stories Feed** (read-only): Fetch a paginated home feed of stories.
- **Get Publication by Hostname** (read-only): Fetch details (id, title, about) of a publication by hostname.
- **Hashnode Add Comment**: Add a comment to a Hashnode post.
- **Hashnode Add Reply**: Add a reply to an existing comment.
- **Hashnode: Fetch User Details** (read-only): Fetch detailed user profile information by username.
- **Hashnode: Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieve details of the currently authenticated user.
- **Fetch Series Posts** (read-only): Fetch posts from a series within a publication.
- **Hashnode Accept Publication Invite**: Accept a publication invitation.
- **Hashnode Remove Reply**: Remove a reply from a comment.
- **Hashnode Update Comment**: Update an existing comment on a Hashnode post.
- **Hashnode Update Reply**: Update a reply.
- **Hashnode: Check Custom Domain Availability** (read-only): Check if a custom domain is available for your Hashnode publication.
- **Hashnode: Fetch Invitations** (read-only): Fetch pending publication invitations.
- **Hashnode: Fetch Popular Tags** (read-only): Fetch a paginated list of popular tags.
- **Hashnode: Like Reply**: Like a reply on Hashnode.
- **Hashnode: List Publications** (read-only): List all publications of the authenticated user.
